name: Spirit of War is exclusive with the other Spirits (#5574, fix #5651)
contract: Issue #5574 (class 12 Barbarian, lvl 51): all Spirit auras show active on the stance bar at once. barbarian-spirit-self-exclusivity.json already proves this for Hunt (707763) vs Savagery (707775); it never casts Spirit of War (712467), the spell actually named by this issue's own prior batch note. aura_ascension_barbarian_lifecycle::Apply (AscensionBarbarianCompletion.cpp) runs its Spirit-exclusivity RemoveAurasDueToSpell loop over all five Spirits {707763, 707764, 707775, 712467, 712468} unconditionally, before the EFFECT_0 guard that broke it pre-#5651 for Hunt and Savagery (whose self markers sit on effect 1/2). This scenario exercises that same loop for War specifically, in both directions.

steps.label: Spirit of the Hunt applies its own aura
Spirit of War applies its own aura
CONTRACT: Spirit of War removes Spirit of the Hunt
Re-casting Spirit of the Hunt applies its own aura again
CONTRACT: Spirit of the Hunt removes Spirit of War
